title: Criteria for Restrictions in Phase Three of Reopening to be Lifted
what_it_is: Criteria for Restrictions in Phase Three of Reopening to be Lifted

sections.label: Phase Three COVID-19 outbreaks
sections.summary: Since entering Phase Three on 28 December 2020, many countries have seen increased COVID-19 outbreaks and more transmissible viral variants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since we entered Phase Three of our reopening on 28 December 2020, we have seen increased COVID-19 outbreaks in many countries around the world and the emergence of more transmissible viral variants.

sections.label: Adjusting safe management measures
sections.summary: Safe management measures will be adjusted from time to time, Phase Three is not expected to end soon, and high vaccination plus discipline is the strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: But given the dynamic situation here and around the world, we will need to adjust our safe management measures from time to time.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We do not expect to move out of Phase Three any time soon.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The vaccines approved in Singapore have been shown to be effective in providing protection against the COVID-19 virus.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are still awaiting more evidence about how effective they will be about preventing transmission.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Meanwhile, our best strategy is to continue to be disciplined about safe management measures and achieve a high level of vaccination within our population to boost our collective immunity.

sections.label: Vaccine approval not rate limiting
sections.summary: The approval or licensure of one given vaccine is not a rate limiting step in that process.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The approval or licensure of one given vaccine is not a rate limiting step in that process.

sections.label: Fundamentals of COVID-19 management
sections.summary: Safe management, hand-washing, PPE, distancing and reducing crowd dwelling time are necessary for as long as the virus is with us.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The fundamentals of how we managed COVID-19 – safe management, hand-washing, PPE, distancing, reducing the dwelling time of crowds in crowded areas – these are going to be necessary and important parts of our fight against COVID-19, for as long as the virus is with us, whatever the variant may be.

sections.label: Testing, contact tracing, quarantine
sections.summary: The fundamentals will be the same: testing people, contact tracing people and then quarantining.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Again, the fundamentals will be the same: that we need to test people, we need to contact trace people and then we need to quarantine.
